about_the_game:
The u4ia - Season 1 - in-game walkthrough will guide you through all the choices in the game, with hints of when to check your phone, activate bonus scenes, find collectables, and open galleries. 

The Walkthrough also contains additional renders, animations, and scenes deemed not good enough for the final cut, and a developer commentary with goofs, mishaps, and explanations for some of the scenes and events in the game.

The DLC also contains additional tools, like relationship togglers, money-cheats, and maximizing stats.

The different DLC features can be accessed by pressing F9 at any screen in the game, where you can toggle the different features on/off, and change stats.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains explicit adult themes, including nudity, violence, and sexual acts (oral, vaginal, anal and light BDSM exploration). All sexual scenes are consensual, and all characters are over the age of 18 years old.

While the game mostly contains a romantic comedic tone, it also verbally depicts a darker backstory to the chain of events happening in the game, including verbal descriptions of a kidnapping, drug usage and death.
